semanticChecks.method: Every field self-reviewed directly against Japanese canonical source. No peer outputs read.
semanticChecks.fullText: Complete titles, paragraphs, prompts, key terms and alt descriptions translated, without summaries.
semanticChecks.conditionsNegationsUncertainty: Preserved source limitations on inference from a plan, prior inspection, single material test, clean surface, equipment availability, payments, training card, laser line, or lack of accidents. Unreceived, unconfirmed and ongoing-check statuses remain distinct.
semanticChecks.technicalDistinctions: Retained project-specific versus standard components; forecast versus actual weather; personnel/materials/methods/machines/funds in this source 5M; performance/material testing versus as-built geometry; budget breakdown/actual incurred costs/payments; predecessor completion versus successor acceptance; worker safety versus community environmental effects; drawing revisions/interfaces/licenses; site setting-out versus component processing marks; calibration/reference linkage/measurement results.
semanticChecks.numbers: The sorted ASCII numeric tokens match each source exactly. Japanese written counts translated as words. The two source 5M tokens remain unchanged.
semanticChecks.addedInstructions: No added procedures, safety instructions, approval thresholds, technical quantities, or operating conditions.
semanticChecks.terminologyCorrection: Tagalog right angle is rendered with the technical loanword to avoid confusing it with a generally correct angle.

limitations: Self-review only; no independent native-speaker or peer review. Technical names and terms such as Career Up Card, 5M, laser, and right angle are retained where precise.
